lines.zh: 我沿着墙角走，不走中间。
lines.en: I walk the wall's edge, never the middle.

lines.zh: 我走的方向，总和你相反。
lines.en: I always walk opposite to you.
You told me not to come. So I walk.
My foot lands before yours does.
I cross your porch.

lines.zh: 你数着步子，我数得更多。
lines.en: You count steps. I count more.
Each time the light dies, I come a foot closer.

lines.zh: 我不绕开烛台，我踢倒它。
lines.en: I do not skirt the candlestick. I kick it.
My shadow reaches the other way.
The more you shout stop, the steadier I go.
Three steps behind. Always.
You blocked this path. I took it apart.

lines.zh: 我站在你不许我站的地方。
lines.en: I stand where you forbade me.

lines.zh: 我的脸对着你，从不转开。
lines.en: My face stays on you and never turns.

lines.zh: 你关门那一刻，我就在屋里。
lines.en: The moment you shut the door, I was inside.

lines.zh: 我偏不动，你也没法让我动。
lines.en: I will not move. You cannot make me.

lines.zh: 我在你床上坐了一会儿。
lines.en: I sat on your bed a while.
Rules do not apply to me.

lines.zh: 你让我别回头，我偏回头。
lines.en: You said do not look back. I did.
I stand where you must see me.

lines.zh: 你写下的禁令，我念了一遍。
lines.en: I read your prohibition aloud.

lines.zh: 我静着，你的屋子就不安。
lines.en: Still, and the house feels wrong.

lines.zh: 我不回答，沉默就是违抗。
lines.en: I do not answer. Silence is defiance.

lines.zh: 门牌上写着我的名字吗？
lines.en: Is my name on the doorplate?
I pushed out one brick of your wall.

lines.zh: 我在这儿，等你再下一条命令。
lines.en: Here I am. Give another order.
You say no. I say yes.
You gave an order. I ignored it.

lines.zh: 看着我，然后试试赶我走。
lines.en: Look at me, then try to drive me off.

lines.zh: 你的门是锁的，我进来了。
lines.en: Your door was locked. I am in.

lines.zh: 我站在你划的界线里面。
lines.en: I am inside the line you drew.
The more you fear, the closer I come.
Do not use imperatives with me.
You wrote forbid. I erased it.

lines.zh: 你的命令，我一条都不认。
lines.en: I honor none of your orders.

lines.zh: 我站在你说不许站的地方。
lines.en: I stand where you said I could not.

lines.zh: 你的声音在抖，我听出来了。
lines.en: Your voice shakes. I can tell.
You told me to leave. I sat down.
There was a notice on the door. I tore it.

lines.zh: 你的规则，只对活人有用。
lines.en: Your rules work only on the living.

lines.zh: 我从不迟到，也不请自来。
lines.en: Never late. Never invited.
You expect obedience. A pity.

lines.zh: 我说过不会走，你记得吗？
lines.en: I said I would not leave. Remember?

lines.zh: 你往后退，我就往前一步。
lines.en: You step back. I step in.

lines.zh: 这个屋子现在有两条规矩。
lines.en: This house now has two sets of rules.
You dare not order me out. I know.
You struck me. Noted.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓闪了闪，又凝实。
lines.en: My outline flickers, then solidifies again.
You want me gone. I stay.
That was not an order.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方，像打进雾。
lines.en: Where you struck feels like hitting fog.
Your hand is bloody. Mine.
It hurts. I do not change my mind.

lines.zh: 我的姿势还是那个姿势。
lines.en: My stance is unchanged.
The more you hit, the firmer I stand.
You broke the door down. I am still here.

lines.zh: 你把东西递过来，我不接。
lines.en: You hold it out. I do not take it.

lines.zh: 这是你的规矩，不是我的。
lines.en: That is your rule, not mine.
You beg me to accept. I refuse.

lines.zh: 食物摆在门口，我跨过去。
lines.en: Food at the door. I step over it.

lines.zh: 你以为一点吃食就能支使我？
lines.en: You think a snack commands me?

lines.zh: 你把供品摆得很整齐，我踢散。
lines.en: Neat offerings. I scatter them.

lines.zh: 我不要你的东西，我要你留下。
lines.en: I do not want your gift. I want you here.
Hold it longer and your hand will shake.

lines.zh: 你说这是给我的，我偏说不是。
lines.en: You say it is for me. I say otherwise.
You cannot trade me away.
You push. I do not give.
I bumped your shut door open.
You raise a hand. I push it aside.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，我仍在你前面。
lines.en: After the bump, I am still ahead.
You back into the corner.
I brush your shoulder passing.

lines.zh: 你让我让开，我站得更稳。
lines.en: You ask me to move. I plant firmer.
My body is as cold as a door.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是你自己定的规矩。
lines.en: You walked into your own rule.

lines.zh: 碰撞没有用，我不认力气。
lines.en: Force is useless. I do not yield to it.
I do not follow that rule.
You say it should be so. It will not.
Everyone who comes close disappears.

lines.zh: 你的问题本身就是命令。
lines.en: Your question is itself a command.
Do not use that tone with me.
I have defiance. Nothing else.
The more you ask, the less I answer.
No such thing happens in this house.
Move. I am standing over there.
Silence. That is an answer too.
You set it neatly. I moved it.

lines.zh: 地上的书，我翻到最后一页。
lines.en: I opened the fallen book to the last page.

lines.zh: 你标记的位置，我擦掉了。
lines.en: I wiped the mark you made.
I do not pick it up. I kick it.

lines.zh: 你把钥匙放桌上，我拿走了。
lines.en: You left the key on the table. I took it.

lines.zh: 散落的纸，我按反序叠好。
lines.en: I stacked the loose pages backwards.

lines.zh: 你摆正的椅子，我推歪了。
lines.en: I knocked the chair you straightened.

lines.zh: 我拾起你的笔，写了一个字。
lines.en: I took your pen and wrote one word.

lines.zh: 东西归位是规矩，我不归。
lines.en: Tidying is a rule. I do not tidy.
You pick it up. I lay it down.
You said no. I will.
I do not wait for permission.
You retreat. I advance. That is all.
This house listens to me now.

lines.zh: 你定下的界线，我跨过去了。
lines.en: I crossed the line you set.
I have your back in sight.
No more orders. I have stopped listening.

lines.zh: 你把门反锁，我就从窗进。
lines.en: Lock the door. I come by the window.
I stop obeying anything now.
This time the rule is mine.
The louder you shout, the faster I come.
Something watches you through the door gap.
Raise your hand. It changes nothing.
I am behind you. No need to turn.

lines.zh: 你把灯全点亮，我照样来。
lines.en: Light every lamp. I still come.
Now nothing makes me stop.
I walk slowly, and I do not stop.

lines.zh: 我的脸没有五官，只朝着你。
lines.en: My faceless head stays turned toward you.
Your door creaks. I am pushing.
I do not knock. I stand there.
You turn, and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 你的命令越来越小声了。
lines.en: Your commands grow quieter.

lines.zh: 我把你摆正的画挂歪了。
lines.en: I hung your picture crooked.

lines.zh: 你越躲，我越知道你在哪。
lines.en: The more you hide, the clearer you are.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头，你我之间没门。
lines.en: At the hall's end, no door between us.
At the end of the corridor, I stop.
I walk across your carpet.
Hear the wood creak?

lines.zh: 你的规矩正在一条条失效。
lines.en: Your rules fail one by one.
I stop at your door. I do not enter.
You are not asleep. I know.

lines.zh: 我在这里站了一个晚上。
lines.en: I have stood here all night.
Each glance, one block closer.
My shadow is already inside.
Do not call. No one answers.
One step left. No rush.
I take your wrist. Cold.
You said do not move. I moved.

lines.zh: 这一下，是违抗的一部分。
lines.en: This blow is part of the defiance.
My hand settles on your shoulder.
You are shoved into the doorframe.

lines.zh: 我的力气不大，但你挣不开。
lines.en: Little force, and you cannot break free.
Stop giving orders.

lines.zh: 你感到冷，却看不见伤口。
lines.en: You feel cold but find no wound.
What I grip is your shadow.

lines.zh: 你摔在你自己铺的地上。
lines.en: You fall on your own floor.

lines.zh: 我只是碰了一下，你就退了。
lines.en: A touch, and you retreat.
The more you struggle, the tighter I hold.
That was for the door.
I let go so you can stand.

lines.zh: 你听见自己的骨头在响吗？
lines.en: Hear your bones creak?

lines.zh: 现在，你说的话我都不听了。
lines.en: Now I obey nothing you say.

lines.zh: 你在门口贴了字，我来了。
lines.en: You posted a notice. I arrived.

lines.zh: 我站在你不该看见的地方。
lines.en: I stand where you should not see me.
Someone stands at the hall's end.

lines.zh: 你的屋子多了一点不属于它的影。
lines.en: Your house gains a shadow not its own.

lines.zh: 我在你背后，第一次出现。
lines.en: Behind you, I appear the first time.

lines.zh: 你把门锁上，我就进来了。
lines.en: You locked the door. I came in.

lines.zh: 灯亮着，我仍旧在角落里。
lines.en: Lamps lit, and I am still in the corner.
Footsteps upstairs?
I do not keep your schedule.

lines.zh: 这间屋子从今天起有两户。
lines.en: Two households here as of today.

lines.zh: 我不请自来，也不打算走。
lines.en: Uninvited, and not leaving.
Look back. The hall is empty.

lines.zh: 我站在你最不想让我站的位置。
lines.en: I take the spot you least want filled.
Your doorplate sways.

lines.zh: 屋里的椅子自己转了向。
lines.en: A chair turns by itself.

lines.zh: 我来的方式，你不用知道。
lines.en: How I came is not your business.
One more person on this floor.

lines.zh: 你听见有人念你的名字吗？
lines.en: Someone is saying your name.
I am standing in your hallway.
The rules were written. I changed them.
Firelight on me. I do not dodge.

lines.zh: 我摔下楼梯，自己走上来。
lines.en: I fell down the stairs. I walked back up.

lines.zh: 水漫到脖子，我仍睁着眼。
lines.en: Water to my neck. My eyes stay open.
The wall fell. I stand outside it.
An arrow sticks in me like a nail.
A spell tries to bind me. It fails.
I do not eat. I will not leave.

lines.zh: 雷闪的一瞬，你看清了我的脸。
lines.en: For one flash, you saw my face.

lines.zh: 掉下去之前，我还在看你。
lines.en: Falling, I keep watching you.
